一.story: **Eve** spent the **knee** day looking for a single, perfect flower, hoping to make it last forever.
**Eve** saw **do**zens of identical flowers, but only one had a single dewdrop glistening on its petal.
**He** stood alone, a single **tree** on a vast, empty plain, contemplating his solitude.

二.story: **Fuad** haggled over the price of the **ta**bles, insisting he only needed **tsu** (two) of them, not a whole set.
**Fuad** and **Rio** were the only two people left in the market, both trying to sell their last wares.
**Fuad** spent **tsu** days trying to sell his goods, but **Carlos** was too busy to even look.

九.story: **Cora** peered over the fence, counting nine little **co**ws in **no** particular order, all munching on **tsu**lips.
**Coop** was the name of the new **gut**ter system installed in the ninth month, just before the autumn rains.
**Coop** closed his shop promptly at nine, just as **Ji** arrived for his evening tea.

七.story: **Nana** carefully arranged the seven **tsu**lips in her vase, each one a different vibrant color.
**Nana** spent **no** less than seven days trying to convince **Carlos** to buy her lucky charm.
**Sheila** finished her chores by seven, just as **Ji** was preparing his evening meal, the last task of her day.

人.story: Every **gin**-soaked night, **Kofi** counts the Mouths lining up at his bar - more Persons through the door every week, the whole neighborhood packed in.
A **knee**-deep crowd surrounds **Kiki**, laughing at everything she says - this Person has an Energy nobody can resist.
**Kai**, the salty sailor, often felt like an outsider, a foreign person among the landlubbers, especially after a **gin** and tonic.

入.story: **Eve** and **Rio** found the **goo**d, old **chi**ldhood entrance to the secret garden, hidden behind overgrown bushes.
**New** students were eager to enter the grand academy, and **Gak** was the first to sign up for enrollment.
**Ha**! **Eve** exclaimed, watching the cat **Rue**sh to enter the small box, disappearing inside.
